rationale: The story is an abstract working-capital mechanism, not a single machine or facility, so a technical isometric cutaway can diagram the funding split with physical engineering detail. review.depicts: An isometric cutaway of two identical warehouse bays divided by a concrete pillar, each with pallet racking holding engine blocks, stacks of yellow parts boxes, and wooden pallets, where the left bay has blank white paperwork slips on the floor (one in a blue tray) and the right bay has a metal C-clamp and a toothed gear sitting on the top shelf.
review.reason: The diptych shows the article's actual mechanism — the same physical stock in two bays, one carrying customer prepayment slips (advance-funded inventory) and one under a clamp and rate gear (debt/carry-cost-funded inventory) — rather than a generic warehouse.
